title: These 30th-anniversary Pokémon guitars are gorgeous and gorgeous-sounding.
summary: Sadly, they’re so limited that they’re only available through a lottery. But these red and green Fenders feature sprites and pixel art from the original games under a transparent, tinted finish, plus a built-in bit crusher for authentic 8-bit tones.
